title: At Death's Door - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: At Death's Door in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: At Death's Door is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Deal 50% increased damage while below 10% Health.

sections.title: How to Get At Death's Door
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
